title: Carina: portrait round 5 (blonde with dark roots, relaxed face)
question: Is any of these Carina, or which parts (hair shape, root or stripe look, face, glasses, clothes) should I combine?

media.caption: Mio and Kuro first (the style anchors), then the round-4 tile you liked ('The very last carina is most interesting'), then the twelve options and the extra seeds of 1 and 4. Your words on round 4: "The very last carina is most interesting, though she is too intense and there is too much dark hair, they are getting dark hair with blonde fringes rather than dark roots/stripes". This round: mostly blonde (golden or honey), dark only as a thumb-width of root at the parting or a few thin dark stripes; a relaxed, warm, slightly amused face with a soft closed-mouth smile and lighter brows and lashes; the face type, shoulder length, side part and tuck behind the ear kept; matte flat fills like Mio and Kuro. HOW THE ROOTS WERE MADE: the model would not draw a thin root band or thin stripes at any prompt weight. Attempts 1 to 8 (blonde weighted 1.5, 'short dark roots at the scalp only', ombre/dip-dye/two-tone/balayage/dark-hair-with-blonde-ends in the negative, then the roots weighted from 1.0 to 1.7, with and without 'ombre' in the positive) all gave plain blonde hair, so the dark roots and stripes were painted onto the finished 2D render afterwards (roots.py: the hair near the forehead hairline is recoloured dark brown, keeping the lineart and cel shadow steps; stripes are a few thin streaks). That makes the roots a bit flat and they are faint on some. If you like one, the real fix is a hand-painted or inpainted root pass on that pick. Option 11 asked for a side fringe and did not get one; options 9 and 12 had the root band shortened after it ran over the temple.
